params.body:
The first proposal of the headers hand failed Portal's own style gate (portal#310): an import the generated provider did not use, and a class name written in full where that project writes it as an import. Both house style, not a fault in the change.

A hand that must know every house style knows none of them well. When the project has Pint, the runner now runs it over exactly the files a file plan wrote, before the tests, so the proposal passes the gate of the people who have to read it. No Pint: the files stay as the hand wrote them.

The step reads the applied paths out of the outcome, so it touches nothing else; package plans are unaffected.
params.title: De opmaak is die van het project: Pint over wat een bestandenplan schreef
